_comment: Text for a published replay (npm run minigame:view): the credit every export carries, and the link preview a --site export writes. {game} is the game's number (the g<n> in its id), {cast} the cast size in words, {turns} the turn count, and {privateTalks} how many times one guest drew another aside.
title: Gonfaloniere: Minigame Replay #{game}
description: A replay of {cast} AI characters scheming in 1492 Florence over {turns} turns. They drew each other aside for {privateTalks}.

credit.text: Adapted from Matt Clifford's Plots in the Palazzo (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)
